## Activity

During March 2026, Central Eye Clinic completed 197 captures. Activity proceeded as expected, with the clinic team maintaining routine operational arrangements throughout the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No further operational issues were identified in the information provided for this report.

The activity figure records the total number of captures completed at the site during the month. It provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 3.0 per cent. This indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded and may require attention through normal quality assurance processes.

The image-quality result is reported alongside total activity to support monitoring of capture performance at Central Eye Clinic. No additional explanation for the ungradable images was recorded in the source information.

## Grading

Grading identified 63 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 2 days. This provides an overall indication of the time taken for results to progress through the grading process during March 2026. The reported grading activity and turnaround should be considered with the image-quality findings above.
